# Open XML dependency

`roxmltree-0.20.0` contains unmodified source and licenses from the published
MIT/Apache-2.0 crate. `UPSTREAM.json` records the exact crates.io archive checksum
and every copied source/license checksum. The tree structure's upstream ISC
credit in `src/lib.rs` is accompanied by the ego-tree license and its source hash.
No network fetch is needed to build Alkyhol's checked PE32 activation profile.

Alkyhol bounds input size/node count, disables DTDs, and rejects every manifest
construct its current runtime cannot implement. XML parsing does not establish
Windows assembly binding, redirection or language-selection equivalence.
